ResearchProjectDef.label: loitering munitions
ResearchProjectDef.description: Cheap delta-wing drones with a piston engine and an explosive warhead. Unlocks the drone launch rail and the Shahed-136.

ResearchProjectDef.label: long-range navigation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Improved inertial and satellite navigation lets drones fly much further. Increases the strike range of all drone launch rails.

ResearchProjectDef.label: reconnaissance drones
ResearchProjectDef.description: Small fixed-wing drones with a camera pod. Launched from the drone launch rail, they fly to a distant tile and circle over it, giving you eyes on the target. A recon drone on station counts as recon for Shahed-136 strikes.

ResearchProjectDef.label: anti-drone guns
ResearchProjectDef.description: Handheld electronic warfare jammers. They blast drone control and navigation frequencies with noise. Unlocks the anti-drone gun, crafted at a machining table. It lets a colonist jam enemy recon drones circling over the colony.

ResearchProjectDef.label: GNSS spoofing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Instead of just drowning out satellite signals, broadcast fake ones. Unlocks the Lima spoofer: a mast-mounted system that feeds incoming drones false positions, sending them far off course so they hit somewhere else.

ResearchProjectDef.label: FPV drones
ResearchProjectDef.description: Small first-person-view quadcopters with an explosive charge. A colonist pilots one into a target on the local map. Crafted at a machining table.

ResearchProjectDef.label: electronic warfare
ResearchProjectDef.description: Broadband radio jammers that drown out drone control links. Unlocks the portable drone jammer (worn by a colonist) and the stationary drone jammer. Hostile FPV drones that fly into their range lose control and collapse.
